traceability.notes: docs/stories/022.0-DEV-JSDOC-COEXISTENCE.story.md defines requirements for allowing @story/@req/@supports annotations to coexist safely with other JSDoc tags, including correct boundary detection, continuation rules, error behavior, documentation, and tests. The implementation updates normalizeCommentLine and adds isNonTraceabilityJSDocTagLine, then wires this into processCommentLine so that any non-traceability JSDoc tag line (e.g., @param, @returns) terminates the current multi-line annotation. New tests in tests/rules/valid-annotation-format.test.ts, explicitly tagged with this story’s requirement IDs, verify before/after/mixed positions, multiline behavior, and that requirement IDs are no longer polluted by following JSDoc tags. The rule documentation has a dedicated 'JSDoc coexistence' section describing and exemplifying the behavior. All Jest tests pass, including those for this story, and existing behaviors remain valid, so all acceptance criteria for 022.0-DEV-JSDOC-COEXISTENCE are satisfied.
